answer_1.quote: The goal of explainable recommendation is to provide an explanation to a user for a recommended item, so as to justify how the recommendation might match his/her interests. That is, given a pair of user ID and item ID, the system needs to generate an explanation.

answer_2.quote: As to explanation performance, we measure the generated explanations from two main perspectives: text quality and explainability. For the former, we adopt BLEU in machine translation and ROUGE in text summarization, and report BLEU-1 and BLEU-4, and Precision, Recall and F1 of ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2. ... we adopt USR that computes the Unique Sentence Ratio ... To this end, we adopt the other three metrics proposed by : Feature Matching Ratio (FMR), Feature Coverage Ratio (FCR) and Feature Diversity (DIV).
